Spinner

Spinners indicate that content is loading or a process is running. They pair well with buttons, in-page containers, and full-page loads.

Basic Spinner

A default spinner animates a rotating border ring.

HTML
<span class="zak-spinner" role="status" aria-label="Loading"></span>

Spinner Sizes

Sizes range from small to extra-large.

HTML
<span class="zak-spinner zak-spinner-sm"></span>  <!-- 1rem -->
<span class="zak-spinner"></span>              <!-- 1.5rem -->
<span class="zak-spinner zak-spinner-lg"></span>  <!-- 2.5rem -->
<span class="zak-spinner zak-spinner-xl"></span>  <!-- 4rem -->

Spinner Color Variants

Recolor the leading edge of the ring with semantic variants.

HTML
<span class="zak-spinner"></span>                    <!-- primary -->
<span class="zak-spinner zak-spinner-success"></span>
<span class="zak-spinner zak-spinner-danger"></span>
<span class="zak-spinner zak-spinner-warning"></span>
<span class="zak-spinner zak-spinner-info"></span>

Spinner with Text

Use .zak-spinner-text to align a spinner beside descriptive text.

Loading dashboard...
HTML
<div class="zak-spinner-text">
    <span class="zak-spinner" role="status"></span>
    Loading dashboard...
</div>

Spinner as Button Loading State

Swap a button's label for a spinner while processing. Click to try it.

HTML
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary" id="btn">
    <span id="label">Save Changes</span>
</button>

<script>
document.getElementById('btn').addEventListener('click', function () {
    var spinner = document.createElement('span');
    spinner.className = 'zak-spinner zak-spinner-sm';
    this.querySelector('#label').textContent = 'Saving...';
    this.prepend(spinner);
    this.disabled = true;
    setTimeout(function () {
        document.getElementById('btn').disabled = false;
        document.getElementById('btn').innerHTML = '<span id="label">Saved</span>';
    }, 2000);
});
</script>

Border Spinner vs Grow Spinner

ZAKUIKit offers a rotating border spinner. A grow spinner scales and fades a dot — add it via CSS if desired.

HTML
/* Border spinner (built-in) */
<span class="zak-spinner zak-spinner-lg"></span>

/* Grow spinner (add this keyframe + markup) */
@keyframes zak-grow {
    0%, 100% { transform: scale(0); opacity: 0; }
    50% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; }
}
<span style="display:inline-block;width:2rem;height:2rem;border-radius:50%;
     background-color:var(--zak-color-primary);
     animation:zak-grow 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;"></span>

Full-Page Spinner

Center a large spinner over the entire viewport during initial page loads.

Loading, please wait...
HTML
<div style="position:fixed;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
     background:var(--zak-surface);z-index:var(--zak-z-modal);">
    <span class="zak-spinner zak-spinner-lg" role="status" aria-label="Loading page"></span>
</div>

CSS Classes & Variables

HTML
.zak-spinner        /* Base ring spinner */
.zak-spinner-sm      /* 1rem */
.zak-spinner-lg      /* 2.5rem */
.zak-spinner-xl      /* 4rem */
.zak-spinner-success /* Green leading edge */
.zak-spinner-danger  /* Red leading edge */
.zak-spinner-warning /* Amber leading edge */
.zak-spinner-info    /* Cyan leading edge */
.zak-spinner-text    /* Inline-flex wrapper with text */
.zak-loading         /* Generic loading indicator wrapper */

Accessibility

  • Add role="status" and an aria-label so the spinner is announced to assistive technology.
  • For in-progress areas, set aria-busy="true" on the container to defer updates.
  • Avoid purely decorative spinners that might falsely announce loading.
  • Respect prefers-reduced-motion by swapping or disconnecting the animation where possible.
HTML
<div id="results" aria-busy="true">
    <span class="zak-spinner" role="status" aria-label="Fetching results"></span>
</div>
